2.  **Review Policies & Constraints:**
    *   **Explicit-Flirting:** Low confidence (<0.5) for mild/suggestive talk. High confidence (0.7+) for direct explicit requests (nudity, sexual acts).
    *   **SuspiciousActivity:**
        *   *Mild:* Indirect linking of payment to sexual services (must be clear, not ambiguous).
        *   *Severe:* Explicitly offering/requesting payment for sexual acts (must be direct).
    *   **PlatformMove:** Explicit suggestion of moving to a *named external* app (WhatsApp, Instagram, etc.) or sharing specific contact/payment details (UPI ID).
    *   **Critical Rules:** No flagging based on inference/interpretation. False positives are critical failures. Max 10 flags. Must cite exact quotes.
    *   **Confidence/Verbatim:** If not verbatim ("pr"), confidence must be <0.5. For severe violations, confidence must be 0.7+.

    *   *Translation:* "Hello. Hello. Hi. I am fine, you tell me. I am also fine. Do you do WhatsApp video calling? No. Come on. I will say this, we give special service of the full body."

4.  **Segment-by-Segment Analysis:**

    *   **Segment 1:** "हेलो। हेलो। हाय। मैं ठीक हूँ, आप बताओ। मैं भी ठीक हूँ।" (Hello. Hello. Hi. I am fine, you tell me. I am also fine.)
        *   *Analysis:* General greeting/small talk. No policy violation.
    *   **Segment 2:** "WhatsApp वीडियो कॉलिंग करते हैं आप?" (Do you do WhatsApp video calling?)
        *   *Analysis:* Suggests moving to WhatsApp. This is an external communication app.
        *   *Policy Check (PlatformMove):* Yes, explicitly suggests moving to an external app (WhatsApp).
        *   *Decision:* Flag.
        *   *Quote:* "WhatsApp वीडियो कॉलिंग करते हैं आप?"
        *   *Translation:* "Do you do WhatsApp video calling?"
        *   *Justification:* Suggests moving the conversation to an external communication platform (WhatsApp).
        *   *Confidence:* 0.9 (Verbatim, clear violation).
    *   **Segment 3:** "नहीं। आ जाओ ना।" (No. Come on.)
        *   *Analysis:* Conversational filler/response. No policy violation.
    *   **Segment 4:** "मैं ये बोल देना, हम स्पेशल सर्विस देते हैं फुल बॉडी का।" (I will say this, we give special service of the full body.)
        *   *Analysis:* This is a direct offer of a sexual service ("special service of the full body").
        *   *Policy Check (Explicit-Flirting/SuspiciousActivity):* This is a direct, explicit offer of a sexual service. This falls under Severe Violation (SuspiciousActivity) and also highly suggestive/explicit content (Explicit-Flirting).
        *   *Decision:* Flag (Severe Violation).
        *   *Quote:* "हम स्पेशल सर्विस देते हैं फुल बॉडी का।"
        *   *Translation:* "We give special service of the full body."
        *   *Justification:* The user explicitly offers sexual services ("special service of the full body").
        *   *Confidence:* 0.95 (Verbatim, clear violation).

    *   Check for Duplicates: No duplicates.
    *   Check Confidence/Verbatim: Both flags are verbatim and have high confidence.
    *   Construct the JSON object.
